SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 12, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
With the exception of Item 6A, all agenda items will be held concurrently with the Thursday, September 12, 2024, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting agenda.

This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the legislative body. Verbal comments will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Mayor/Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Mayor/Chair extends.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD THURSDAY,
SEPTEMBER 12, 2024, 7:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

 With the exception of Item 6A, all agenda items listed below were considered concurrently with
 the Thursday, September 12, 2024, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
 agenda.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

 2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

 3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Councilmember Bruce W. Barrows.

 4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council were in attendance:

  Councilmember Bruce W. Barrows
  Councilmember Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Councilmember Member Frank Aurelio Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem Chuong Vo
  Mayor Naresh Solanki

 5.  Public Comments and Suggestions

 Special meeting public comments on Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and items not listed on the
 agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the legislative body were heard during
 Item 6 as listed on the Thursday, September 12, 2024, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency
 Regular Meeting agenda. A summary of the public comments is listed in the minutes of the
 Thursday, September 12, 2024, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting.

 6.  New and Old Business

 6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 2.15 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO
  EXTEND THE TWO-YEAR TERMS OF OFFICE FOR 2022-24 ADVISORY BOARD,
  COMMISSION, AND COMMITTEE MEMBERS (COUNCIL).

 This item was considered immediately following the New and Old Business Item 9B listed on
 the Thursday, September 12, 2024, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
 agenda.

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  David Pylman expressed concern with the protocol for the development of new Advisory
  Boards, Commissions, and Commissions and the selection of their corresponding
  advisory board members.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, September 12, 2024, 7:00 p.m.
City Council Special Meeting  Page 2 of 3

6.  New and Old Business (continued)

6A.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama and seconded by Barrows to waive full reading of and
  introduce Ordinance No. 1047, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  AMENDING CHAPTER 2.15 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO EXTEND THE
  TWO-YEAR TERMS OF OFFICE FOR 2022-24 ADVISORY BOARD, COMMISSION, AND
  COMMITTEE MEMBERS (COUNCIL), containing the modifications to the Cerritos Municipal
  Code chapter 2.15 with deletions in strikeout text and additions in bold italics text:

  Chapter 2.15 - Advisory Boards, Commissions, and Committees Section

  2.15.010 Terms of Office

  (a) All City Council appointments to City of Cerritos Advisory Boards, Commissions, and
  Committees shall be for a term of two years commencing on the 1st day of the month
  after the Annual Mayoral Transition conducted in even odd-numbered years to coincide
  with the City's General Municipal Election cycle; or shall expire earlier if the
  Councilmember making the appointment ceases to hold office as a member of the
  Cerritos City Council. Persons appointed may be removed by action of the
  Councilmember making the appointment, subject to approval by the City Council or by
  a majority vote of the City Council. Appointments may be extended pursuant to
  subsection (b) of this section;

  (b) The term of any regular member of any City of Cerritos Advisory Board,
  Commission, or Committee is automatically extended for not more than ninety days
  pending the qualification of his or her successor;

  (c) If a vacancy shall occur otherwise than by expiration of term, it shall be filled by
  appointment for the unexpired portion of the term. Such appointment shall be made by
  the Councilmember making the original appointment, with the approval of the City
  Council; and

  (d) Notwithstanding subsection (b) of this section, for members serving the 2022- 2024
  term only, the term of any regular member of any City of Cerritos Advisory Board,
  Commission, or Committee is automatically extended for not more than one hundred
  eighty days through and including the last day of the month in which the Mayor
  is selected pursuant to Section 404 of the Cerritos City Charter as part of the
  2025 annual Mayoral Transition, pending the qualification of his or her successor.

  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Johnson, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:27 p.m.
